name: onboarding_abandoned
description: A person explicitly left an onboarding flow without completing it. Only for abandonment the product can actually observe.
trigger: The person takes an action that ends the flow — dismissing it, choosing “skip for now”, or navigating away from a flow that cannot be resumed.
nonTriggers: Do not fire because the person stopped emitting events. Absence of activity is not abandonment, and inferring it here makes the drop-off number unfalsifiable.
Do not fire on a session or tab closing; the person may resume the flow later.
Do not fire on a flow the product has never presented.

properties.name: flow_id
properties.description: Stable identifier of the onboarding flow, e.g. initial_setup. A flow, not a flow run.

properties.name: last_step_id
properties.description: The last step completed before abandonment, if any. Absent means none.
